messages:
maria_support: Customer reporting tool/function call failures when passing CLI-generated JSON. API returns 400 schema validation error. Copy of failing request attached.

 dan_dev: Can you paste the exact request body and curl? Also what client? Windows cmd/powershell/curl?

 maria_support: They used curl on Windows (Git Bash) with a one-liner. Here's the raw body they sent:
```
{
  \"tool\": \"pdf_extractor\",
  \"args\": {
    \"path\": \"C:\\\\Users\\\\alice\\\\Documents\\\\report.pdf\",
    \"pages\": [1,2,3],
    \"note\": \"Exported on 2026-03-15\",
  },
}
```

 maria_support: API response:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{\"error\":\"invalid_tool_args\",\"message\":\"JSON parse error: Trailing comma after object member at offset 103\"}
```

 lee_sre: Trailing commas + Windows backslashes. Backslashes okay if escaped but trailing commas are invalid JSON. Could be the client shell strip/transform? :thinking_face:

 dan_dev: Also note the path contains percent-like sequences? Not here. But Git Bash sometimes auto-converts quotes. Any chance the customer double-quoted then single-quoted in curl? Could be quoting mismatch causing backslash unescape.

 maria_support: Customer says they pasted from a PowerShell snippet originally; then used Git Bash. They assert request body is exactly as above. They also showed the curl command:
```
curl -s -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/call\" \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  --data-binary '{\"tool\":\"pdf_extractor\",\"args\":{\"path\":\"C:\\\\Users\\\\alice\\\\Documents\\\\report.pdf\",\"pages\":[1,2,3],\"note\":\"Exported\" ,}}'
```

 ana_engineer: Aha — note the extra space before comma and the double trailing comma sequence `,}}` — that'll absolutely break the JSON parser after our pre-processor tries to normalize. Also some shells will remove escaping leading to `C:\\\\Users\\\\...` -> `C:\\Users\\...` which then can create invalid escape like `\\U` (unicode escape) in some parsers.

 toolbot: automated-check: payload_schema=v2.1; validation_error=TrailingComma; parser=jsontok; hint=remove-trailing-commas-or-send-ndjson

 maria_support: Customer insists other endpoints accept similar payloads — they're seeing inconsistent behavior. Could be client lib that used a \"relaxed\" parser for other endpoints but strict checker on toolargs.

 lee_sre: Repro steps I ran (local mac): used their curl verbatim -> got same 400. If I remove trailing commas and keep backslashes escaped it succeeds. Quick workaround: ask customer to use --data '@file.json' or to JSON.stringify in their client.

 dan_dev: We should add a clearer error message: point to the exact char/offset and mention trailing comma. Logging ticket filed: ENG-SET-5023. @ana_engineer can you own the fix? We can also add a helpful FAQ for Windows/PowerShell quoting.

 ana_engineer: Taking it. Plan: improve parser error to indicate trailing comma and show snippet; add docs entry for Windows/PowerShell quoting; consider accepting \"relaxed\" JSON only for legacy compatibility behind flag. For now advise support to recommend --data @payload.json or to wrap path in double escaping (\\\\) or base64 encode args.

 maria_support: I sent the workaround to customer (attach file + example). They confirmed workaround worked (manual file upload route) and will try base64-b64 wrapper. Marking as awaiting customer verification.

 lee_sre: Closing as external workaround applied. React with :white_check_mark: when resolved.
